scripts.build: pnpm bundle && cross-env WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler deploy --dry-run --no-bundle --outdir dist
scripts.db:migrate:local: cross-env WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler d1 migrations apply ticket-radar-db --local
scripts.db:seed:local: cross-env WRANGLER_LOG_PATH=.wrangler/logs/wrangler.log wrangler d1 execute ticket-radar-db --local --file seeds/seed.sql
